name: Smoulderer's Flask
desc: Grain Spirit, Quicksilver, Emberbloom, Brimstone. Spirit and quicksilver put volatility past 1.2, so the brimstone ignites: a Flask of about 13 heat damage plus On Fire at Fair grade.

name: Thief's Measure
desc: Spring Water, Gloomcap, Fixing Salt. An Elixir granting Concealed (×0.65 at Fair grade) for 45 seconds. The salt has no effect: nothing roused the brew.

name: Field Salve
desc: Pressed Oil, Mendroot, Mendroot, Fixing Salt. A Salve: about 19 HP at Fair grade, and cures poison and bleed. The salt has no effect: nothing roused the brew.

name: Chokedamp
desc: Grain Spirit, Nightcap, Fixing Salt. The salt drops volatility from 0.5 to 0.15, so it is a Fume, not a Flask: Poisoned on every enemy for 53 seconds at Fair grade.
